title: Ward Vital Alert Rollup Transfer
goal: Ingest bedside monitor CSV exports for multiple patients, handle blank sensor readings, and produce a per-alert CSV that collapses consecutive abnormal heart-rate or SpO2 samples into alert windows with patient_id, alert_type, start/end times, lowest or highest observed value, and recovery time.
skillBenefitRationale: Success depends on time-series CSV processing with pandas-style operations: missing-value handling, threshold filtering, grouping adjacent abnormal rows by patient, deriving recovery metrics, and emitting a clean summary CSV.
